types.Card: string, two characters: rank 2-9 T J Q K A then suit c d h s
types.OddsCard: {code:Card|null,rank:string|null,suit:string|null,from:'hole'|'board'|'needed',spare:boolean}; a known card or one still to come, kickers marked spare
types.OddsRow: {category:string,rank:number,probability:number,cards:OddsCard[],more:boolean}; rank 1 is a royal flush, probability is 1 for the hand already made

rows.returns: OddsRow[] (the made hand first, then every better way with the exact chance it arrives by the river, most likely first)

chance.returns: number (exact chance the needed cards are among the cards still to come)

shownCards.returns: OddsCard[] (a shown hand's combination in reading order, then the first kickers)

winChance.returns: number (chance of holding the best hand at the river; ties count a share; ranges give each opponent's lowest assumed starting score, or a count of unconstrained opponents)
